scope: Proposition 6.3 (Three active incidences) of the manuscript “A counterexample to Sidorenko's conjecture” (preprints/A-counterexample-to-Sidorenkos-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 161 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0c0d7b5eb1ed43c0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a local profile (h1, h2, h3, c), we choose one pointwise gain exponent independent of q as follows. Let U be the union, over all odd prime fields and all ordered orbits of this profile, of the parameter tuples arising from actual quadruples (L1, L2, L3, Y ) with the stated point profile and dim(Li ∩ Y ) = r, using Equations (6.8) and (6.10). Their integer entries are bounded at fixed D, so U is finite. If U is empty, the face factor is zero over every odd prime field. Otherwise the face factor with three active incidences is O(qg) uniformly over all triples in the profile, where g = max tuple∈U ( gC + X i b(si) − δP − X i p2 i − vw − X i b(ti) + b(v) ) , (6.17) so the selected exponent is independent of q. Every tuple in U satisfies the following necessary constraints: 0 ≤ u ≤ min(c, r), 0 ≤ r′ = r − u ≤ d, |δ| ≤ c, d − δ = 2r′ , P + T = X i si ≤ d, 0 ≤ ti ≤ pi + δ, 0 ≤ v ≤ pi + δ (1 ≤ i ≤ 3), w ≥ 0. (6.18) In particular T ≤ P +3δ and d+3δ ≥ 0. These conditions are not claimed sufficient for realizability.
